title: Alcohol (surface)
html:
Alcohol is a type of surface created by throwing or otherwise breaking a container of alcohol. It can be ignited or frozen.

Description

Flammable.

Properties

Type: Surface

Creation

This area can be created by the following:

Interactions

  • Turns into an  Ice surface if exposed to sources of cold damage. Affected area melts into a  Water surface after Duration: 2 turns.
  • Turns into a  Fire if exposed to sources of fire damage. Affected area dissipates into an  Ash surface after Duration: 2 turns.
